task.title: Remote Camera Control
task.shortdesc: Use your phone as a camera source and control it remotely from the touch interface.

context.p: Once paired, StreamForge Mobile can act as a wireless camera source, and its touch controls let you adjust the shot without touching the phone itself once it's mounted.

step.cmd: On the phone, tap Start Camera.
Use the on-screen pinch gesture to zoom, and drag to pan within the sensor's field of view.
Tap the focus reticle on a subject to lock focus and exposure to that point.

taskbody.result: The paired desktop product receives the video feed as a live camera source that updates as you adjust framing from the phone.
